correctness.rationale: Direct substitution into the literal cutoff map verifies the one-step and two-step section returns with sign flips, with roof r(z)=2 for z<1-theta and 1 otherwise. The signed arcs A_sigma,B_sigma fit exactly into W in [0,2h), h=2-theta, and all three transition types become W->W+1 modulo 2h. Irrationality yields Haar measure, integrals of t dt/t give displayed second moments and reset frequency 1/h. Roof-wrap count telescopes to H_n; the error is {z+n*theta}-z in (-1,1). An independent literal iteration comparison matched 1,800 states for three parameter choices. Seams and other equilibrium components are excluded.
